credit_spreads.name: NIFTY Credit Spreads
credit_spreads.description: Sells defined-risk credit spreads on the NIFTY option chain, with a screener, margin check and exit rules. VIX kill switch: above the VIX limit (default 13.5) it takes no new trades and closes all open spreads.

ema_hedge.name: NIFTY EMA Breakout Hedge
ema_hedge.description: The Pine 100 EMA breakout (40 EMA stop) run on the NIFTY index, traded as hedged ATM option spreads - one leg sold, one bought - in the current 4 expiries. VIX kill switch: above the VIX limit (default 13.5) it opens no spreads and closes all open ones.

level_cross.name: NIFTY 2-Level Cross
level_cross.description: Buys one option when its premium crosses up through Level 2 or Level 3 with momentum. Exits on a VIX-based target, a trailing stop, or a failed push.

macd_monthly.name: NIFTY MACD - Monthly 1000s
macd_monthly.description: MACD 30/60/15 cross on each option's own premium, on monthly-expiry strikes in multiples of 1000 (CE and PE). Enters only between Rs 144 and 1600 with yesterday's India VIX at 15 or below.

scalper.name: NIFTY Scalper - IVX-G
scalper.description: Buys one ATM option when volatility is rising, with a per-day loss budget and a hard trade cap.

stock_ema_cross.name: Stock Options EMA Cross
stock_ema_cross.description: Buys ATM +/- 3 strike options of the Nifty 100 stocks when the premium crosses up through its 30-minute EMA 144 with momentum. Exits on a quick 15%, a 70% target, a Rs profit target, a close under EMA 55, or before a holiday.
